comment: Dispatch surface of the specialized SM90 small-T/banded dsfp8 fused-MoE fast path, behind cutlass_fused_moe's 'specialized' backend. 'backends' lists the backend strings; the op entry carries the auto-routing keys INCLUDING THE MEASURED WON BANDS backend='auto' admits (the compiled-in guards in flashinfer/fused_moe/smallt_sm90.py stay authoritative). The 17..255 gap — containing the measured T=64 class where the stock kernel held — stays on the stock route by design. FLASHINFER_SPECIALIZED_KERNEL_DISABLE=1 forces the stock route regardless of this file.

cutlass_fused_moe_dsfp8.quant: deepseek fp8 [128,128] block-scale (fc1/fc2 f32 scale grids)
cutlass_fused_moe_dsfp8.band_note: interior points admitted by band interpolation between measured classes; 17..255 (incl. the measured T=64 class, where the stock kernel held) stays stock
